title: [Peek] Enable reusable previewers for Peek to fix flicker

status.detail: The upstream head is unchanged. The fork review advanced through two newer Copilot rounds: FilePreview.xaml.cs now ignores canceled or superseded async preview failures before logging or setting Error state, the scaling-factor callback handles cancellation from stale resize requests, and Peek.Common.UnitTests now verifies the production ImagePreviewer and UnsupportedFilePreviewer registrations are selected as reusable. The fixes were pushed through b8fd2dd75720d4d8a90f66df4f94f23e3278a226, all current fork Copilot comments were replied to and resolved, and unresolved fork Copilot thread count is 0. The one immediate Copilot reviewer request in this drain turn returned an empty requested-reviewers assignment, so the required fresh zero-comment convergence round after the latest fork head still cannot run. No upstream action is proposed.
